sources.quote: External dimensions Approximately 7 1/2 x 7 3/4 x 3 inches (W x D x H)

sources.method: 25.4 mm/in x the inch figures of sources[0] (Sega of America manual, W 7 1/2, D 7 3/4, H 3 in): width 190.5, depth 196.85, height 76.2 mm, exact products, not rounded

notes: Source: archive.org scan of Sega of America's 'DreamCast Instruction Manual' (2000, US), page 30 'RATINGS AND SPECIFICATIONS'; quotes are clean lines of the scan's OCR text layer. Counts as primary.
Envelope: Sega prints approximate fractional inches labelled W x D x H; the mm values are a derived conversion (tier derived), so their real precision is about 1/4 in.
Mass not filed: the manual says 'Weight Approximately 3 pounds', a whole-pound figure, too coarse to convert.
media: the 'PART NAMES' front view labels the 'Disc door', opened by the 'OPEN button' (a top-opening disc lid): disc_lid.

controls: the front view labels 'POWER button' and 'OPEN button' (and a 'Power indicator', not a control). The OPEN button is filed as eject_button (it releases the disc door); no reset button is labelled.

Ports not filed: front 'Control ports A to D' (connector type not stated), back 'Power terminal', 'AV terminal', 'Serial terminal (for possible future expandability)', and the 'Modem' with its 'Phone jack'.

Science Museum Group co8912915 reportedly gives 'overall: 75 mm x 190 mm x 195 mm' (axes unlabelled; SMG returned 429 to this pass, not re-read). CHM 102674794 includes the outer box and is not used. Sega's archive page (www.sega.jp/fb/segahard/dc/data.html, URL per earlier research) returns 403.
